svg.aria-label: Line graph titled Median Ages of First Marriage for Men and Women in the United States and in England and Wales, 1900–2000. The horizontal axis is labeled Years. It ranges from 1900 to 2000 in increments of 10. The vertical axis is labeled Median marriage age. It ranges from 0 to 35 in increments of 5. 4 lines are shown. Refer to long description.
